error.command.bad_params: The engine refused a request because its {field} value was not valid. Restart the engine; if this keeps happening, the app log has details.
error.command.unknown: This version of the engine does not support the request {name}. The app and the engine may be from different versions.
error.engine.internal: The engine hit an internal error ({exception_type}) and kept running. The engine log has details.
error.protocol.bad_encoding: The engine received a message that was not valid text. Restart the engine; if this keeps happening, the app log has details.
error.protocol.bad_envelope: The engine received a malformed message (field {field}). Restart the engine; if this keeps happening, the app log has details.
error.protocol.bad_json: The engine received a message it could not read. Restart the engine; if this keeps happening, the app log has details.
error.protocol.hello_required: The app sent the request {name} before the engine was ready. Restart the engine.
error.protocol.line_too_long: A message to the engine was over its limit of {limit_bytes, number} bytes and was dropped.
error.protocol.unsupported_version: The app and the engine speak different protocol versions. Install matching versions of both.
error.unknown: Something went wrong (code {code}). The app log has details.
